# Workflows

Default target: Clay

## Targets

### Clay

Author and validate through the seeded Clay surface. Test drafts, estimate credits, and publish after a separate gate. The agent can publish. Live keeps old logic until publish. Inspect state and runs by workflow ID. Definitions and runs live in Clay. Connections live in-app and credits are usage based.
